description: Read one feature (or bug) of the attached project LIVE from Fabric: full description, acceptance criteria, status, priority and every task with its completion. Pass the identifier the user mentions (e.g. 'F-040') or an id from fabric_list_project_features. A prefix is exact: 'F-001' never returns bug B-001 — when the item does not exist the tool says so. It also returns items the roadmap hides (declined, or closed); those exist, and onRoadmap=false with hiddenReason says why the roadmap does not show them.

feature.description: Identifier exactly as the user wrote it (e.g. 'F-040', 'B-002', '40') or an id from fabric_list_project_features.
